Which of the following statements is/are true?

**Statement A :**

Variations arising during the process of reproduction can be inherited.

**Statement B :**

Changes in the non-reproductive tissues caused by environmental factors are not inheritable.

options.text: Statement A is true and Statement B is false
Statement B is true and Statement A is false
Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false

questions.solution:
**__Concept:__**

__
 
• A **mutation is a sudden change in the DNA sequence of an organism**.
 
• Hugo De Vries was the first one to study mutations in *Oenothera Lamarckiana*.
 
• Mutations can be harmful, beneficial, or have no effect.
 
• Two major categories of mutations are
 
 
• **germline mutations**
 
• **somatic mutations.**
 
 
 
• Mutations that occur in the germ cells i.e., Germline mutations (that occur in eggs and sperm), are inheritable and can be passed on to offspring.
 
• The somatic mutations (that occur in body cells) are not inheritable and are not passed on to the next generations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

**Statement A - **

 
• The variations that occur during the reproduction, they occur in the germ cells.
 
• This is known as **germ line mutation**.
 
• A gene change in a body's reproductive cell (egg or sperm) can become incorporated into the DNA of every cell in the body of the offspring. 
 
• The variations occurring in the germ cells **can be inherited**.
 
• Therefore **statement A is true.**

**Statement B - **

 
• Changes in the **non-reproductive tissues caused by environmental factors** occur in the somatic cells.
 
• This is known as **somatic mutation**.
 
• These changes are **not heritable**.
 
• Somatic mutations can occur in any of the body cells except the germ cells (sperm and egg).
 
• Therefore **statement B is true.**

Therefore, the correct answer is option 3.

• Spinning is a process of twisting fibers together to make yarn or thread. It is not related to the extraction of metals from their ores.

• Heaving is a geological process that occurs due to the expansion of soil or rocks when they freeze. The expansion can cause the soil or rocks to move upward, which can lead to landslides or other geological hazards.

questions.question: Rolling friction is ______ the sliding friction.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Less than**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rolling friction** is caused when an object rolls over a surface. It is generally much smaller compared to sliding friction because less surface area is in contact during rolling.
 
• **Sliding friction** occurs when an object slides across a surface. It involves greater surface area in contact, leading to higher resistance compared to rolling friction.
 
• The force required to overcome rolling friction is significantly less than that required to overcome sliding friction because rolling minimizes interlocking of surface irregularities. *Hence, rolling friction is less than sliding friction.*
 
• **Rolling friction** is influenced by factors such as the material of the rolling object and the surface, the radius of the object, and the applied force. This is why tires and wheels are designed to roll efficiently, reducing energy loss.
 
• Sliding friction typically generates more heat and energy loss compared to rolling friction, making rolling mechanisms more energy-efficient. *Hence, the correct answer is "Less than."*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Factors Affecting Rolling Friction:**

 
 
• **Surface texture:** Smooth surfaces have lower rolling friction, while rough surfaces increase resistance.
 
• **Material properties:** Harder materials reduce rolling friction as they deform less compared to softer materials.
 
• **Radius of rolling object:** Larger radius objects experience less rolling friction because they reduce the deformation at the contact point.
 
 
 
• **Applications of Rolling Friction:**
 
 
• **Transportation:** Wheels, tires, and ball bearings are designed to reduce rolling friction for efficient movement.
 
• **Industrial machinery:** Rollers and conveyor belts utilize rolling friction to transport goods with minimal energy loss.
 
• **Sports:** Rolling friction plays a role in the movement of balls and wheels in sports like cycling, bowling, and soccer.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Sliding vs Rolling Friction:**

 
 
• **Sliding friction:** Larger contact area leads to greater resistance, more heat generation, and energy loss.
 
• **Rolling friction:** Smaller contact area and reduced interlocking of surface irregularities result in lower resistance and greater efficiency.
 
 
 
• **Examples:**
 
 
• **Bicycle wheels:** Designed to minimize rolling friction for smooth and energy-efficient riding.
 
• **Ball bearings:** Used in machinery to reduce friction and wear during rotational movement.
 
• **Road vehicles:** Tires are engineered to optimize rolling friction while maintaining grip and safety.

questions.question: A person burned a firecracker in front of a cliff and heard its echo 5 s after it burst. The distance of the cliff from the person, if the speed of the sound is 340 m/s, is close to
questions.solution:
__**Concept**__:

__
 
• To calculate the distance of the cliff from the person, we need to consider the time it took for the sound to travel from the person to the cliff and back as an echo.
 
• The sound traveled from the person to the cliff, and then the echo traveled back to the person.
 
• So the total time it took for the sound to travel is twice the time it took to hear the echo.

**Calculation:**__

Given that

The echo was heard 5 seconds after the firecracker burst, we can determine the time it took for the sound to travel from the person to the cliff and back as 5 seconds divided by 2, which is 2.5 seconds.

T = 2.5 sec

Using the formula:

Distance = Speed × Time, we can calculate the distance of the cliff from the person:

Distance = 340 m/s × 2.5 s = 850 meters

Therefore, the distance of the cliff from the person is approximately 850 meters.

**The correct answer is option (4)**

questions.question: Variation is useful for the survival of species over time. These variations occur due to errors in:
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**DNA copying**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Variations are crucial for the survival and evolution of species, providing a way for organisms to adapt to changing environments.
 
• These variations occur due to errors in the DNA copying process during cell division.
 
• Such errors, known as mutations, can introduce new traits in organisms which may enhance their survival and reproduction.
 
• While some mutations can be harmful, others can be beneficial and contribute to the genetic diversity of a population.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **DNA Replication:**

 
 
• DNA replication is the process by which a DNA molecule makes a copy of itself during cell division.
 
• It ensures that each new cell receives an exact copy of the organism's genetic material.
 
• The process involves enzymes like DNA polymerase, which helps in adding nucleotides to the growing DNA strand.
 
 
 
• **Mutation:**
 
 
• A mutation is a change in the DNA sequence that can lead to variations in the genetic code.
 
• Mutations can occur spontaneously or be induced by external factors such as radiation and chemicals.
 
• They play a critical role in evolution by introducing new genetic variations.
 
 
 
• **Genetic Variation:**
 
 
• Genetic variation refers to the differences in DNA sequences among individuals within a population.
 
• It is essential for natural selection, as it provides the raw material for evolutionary change.
 
• High genetic variation within a population increases its ability to adapt to environmental changes.
 
 
 
• **Natural Selection:**
 
 
• Natural selection is the process by which organisms with advantageous traits are more likely to survive and reproduce.
 
• Over time, these advantageous traits become more common within the population.
 
• Natural selection drives the evolution of species by favoring traits that enhance survival and reproductive success.

questions.question: An object is placed infront of a concave lens between the optical centre and the focus. The image is:
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 3) i.e. Virtual, diminished

__**CONCEPT**__:

__
 
• Concave lens: It is a diverging lens that diverges the parallel beam of light.

 
 
• It can also gather light from all directions and project it as a parallel beam.
 
• The focal length of the concave lens is negative.
 
• It has a virtual focus from the diverging rays of light that seem to converge.
 
 

 
• **Images formed by concave lenses**:

 
 
• Images are always **smaller **than the object, **erect**, and **virtual**.
 
• As the **distance between the object and the lens decreases**, the size of the **virtual image** **increases **as the distance between the virtual image and the mirror decreases.
 
 

**​EXPLANATION__**:

 
• A concave lens never forms an enlarged image.
 
• Following two conditions are possible in the concave lens:
 
 
• When the object is placed at infinity - The image is formed at F1; the image formed is virtual, erect, and highly-diminished.
 
• When the object is placed between infinity and O - The image is formed between F1 and O; the image formed is virtual, erect, and diminished.
 
 
 
• Following diagrammatic representations show the image formation by the concave lens: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a9b9b7a4f890439258c1edf0db2620be410f2ec47e0210b91ba25ae5f683495f.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2990a550a916cf0f27599d68850c1ec51262aafd5c5449efbb4b2a263b6b291c.png] 

 
• When an object is placed between the optical center and focus, it will be at the maximum possible nearest to the lens.
 
• Therefore, the object will produce an image that is smaller in size than the object itself.
 
• Hence, an **object is placed in front of a concave lens between the optical centre and the focus produces virtual and diminished images.**

become nine times of its original value

So,** loudness ∝ (amplitude)²**

loudness ∝ (3)² x (amplitude)²

loudness ∝ 9 × (amplitude)²

questions.question: What compound is formed when a small amount of hydrochloric acid is added to a beaker containing copper oxide?

The correct answer is __**Copper (II) chloride**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

• The balanced chemical equation for this reaction is: CuO + 2HCl → CuCl₂ + H₂O.
 
• This reaction is an example of a neutralization reaction where an acid reacts with a base (metal oxide) to produce a salt and water.
 
• Copper (II) chloride is a compound with copper in the +2 oxidation state, which is the most stable oxidation state for copper in aqueous solutions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hydrochloric Acid (HCl)**

 
 
• Hydrochloric acid is a strong, corrosive acid commonly used in laboratory and industrial applications.
 
• It is a solution of hydrogen chloride in water and is known for its pungent smell.
 
• HCl is widely used for cleaning metals, in the production of organic compounds, and in the food industry for processing and cleaning.
 
 
 
• **Copper Oxide (CuO)**
 
 
• Copper oxide is a black solid that is used as a pigment in ceramics and glass.
 
• It is a basic oxide, meaning it reacts with acids to form salts and water.
 
• CuO is also used in the production of copper salts and as a catalyst in chemical reactions.
 
 
 
• **Copper (II) Chloride (CuCl₂)**
 
 
• Copper (II) chloride is a yellow-brown solid that dissolves in water to form a blue-green solution.
 
• It is used in dyeing, printing, and in various chemical syntheses.
 
• CuCl₂ can also act as a catalyst in organic reactions and is used in water treatment processes.
 
 
 
• **Neutralization Reaction**
 
 
• A neutralization reaction is a chemical reaction in which an acid and a base react to form a salt and water.
 
• This type of reaction typically results in the neutralization of the pH of the reacting solutions.
 
• Neutralization reactions are fundamental in various industrial processes and in everyday life, such as in antacid tablets used to relieve heartburn.

questions.question: What happens when acid is mixed with water?

options.text: It will increase the concentration of hydronium ions per unit volume.
It will increase the concentration of hydroxyl ions per unit volume.
There will be no effect on the concentration of ions.
It will decrease the concentration of hydronium ions per unit volume.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**It will decrease the concentration of hydronium ions per unit volume.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• When an **acid is mixed with water**, it undergoes **ionization** and produces **hydronium ions (H₃O⁺)**.
 
• However, since the acid solution is **diluted by adding water**, the **concentration of hydronium ions per unit volume decreases**, even though the total number of hydronium ions may increase.
 
• This dilution makes the acidic solution **less concentrated** and increases its **pH**.
 
• ***Hence, the correct answer is Option 4 – It will decrease the concentration of hydronium ions per unit volume.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__

questions.question: If x+(1)/(3x)=5, then the value of 27x³+(1)/(x³) will be:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Multiply the given equation by 3: **3x + 1/x = 15**.

Use the direct shortcut: If **a + b = k**, then **a³ + b³ = k³ − 3abk**.

Here, **a = 3x**, **b = 1/x**, so **ab = 3** and **k = 15**.

Value = 15³ − 3 × 3 × 15 = 3375 − 135 = 3240.

**∴ The correct answer is 3240.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** x + 1/(3x) = 5

**Formula Used:** (a + b)³ = a³ + b³ + 3ab(a + b)

⇒ Multiply the given equation by 3 on both sides:

⇒ 3 × (x + 1/(3x)) = 3 × 5

⇒ 3x + 1/x = 15

⇒ **Cubing both sides** of the equation:

⇒ (3x + 1/x)³ = 15³

⇒ (3x)³ + (1/x)³ + 3 × 3x × (1/x) × (3x + 1/x) = 3375

⇒ 27x³ + 1/x³ + 9 × (3x + 1/x) = 3375

⇒ Substitute (3x + 1/x) = 15:

⇒ 27x³ + 1/x³ + 9 × 15 = 3375

⇒ 27x³ + 1/x³ + 135 = 3375

⇒ 27x³ + 1/x³ = 3375 − 135 = 3240

**∴ The correct answer is 3240.**

**__Additional Information__**

Algebraic Cube Identity

The basic identity for the cube of a sum is (a + b)³ = a³ + b³ + 3ab(a + b). It is frequently used to find the sum of cubes when the sum and product of two terms are known.

Reciprocal Power Shortcut

If x + 1/x = k, then x³ + 1/x³ = k³ − 3k. This can be extended to coefficients: if ax + b/x = k, then (ax)³ + (b/x)³ = k³ − 3(ab)k.

Successive Calculation

To find higher powers like x⁶, first find the square (x² + 1/x²) and then cube that result, or vice versa.</p

questions.question: A batsman has a certain average of runs for 58 innings. In the 59th inning he scores 117 runs there by increasing his average 1.5 runs. What will be his average after 59th innings.

New Average = Score in **last inning** − (**Previous innings** × Increase in average)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Average = Total Runs ÷ Number of Innings

**Calculations:**

Total Run Increase

The total increase in runs across all innings is calculated as: Increase = New Innings × Increase in average (59 × 1.5 = 88.5).

Net Deviation

Score of new inning = Old Average + (New total count × Average Increase).</p

questions.question: A certain sum of money amounts to Rs. 900 in 2 years and Rs. 1080 in 5 years at simple interest. What is the annual rate of interest?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Interest for 3 years (5 − 2) = Rs. 1080 − Rs. 900 = Rs. 180.

Interest for 1 year = Rs. 180 ÷ 3 = Rs. 60.

**Principal (P)** = Amount after 2 years − (2 × Interest per year) = 900 − 120 = Rs. 780.

**Rate (R)** = (Interest per year ÷ Principal) × 100 = (60 ÷ 780) × 100 = 7.69%.

**∴ The correct answer is 7.69 percent.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Amount after 2 years (A₂) = Rs. 900, Amount after 5 years (A₅) = Rs. 1080.

**Formula Used:** Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100; Amount (A) = Principal (P) + SI.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f4ff6a83309e84d2bbbf81a8ee963c0ff0b1edfc9a37690afc4a394bcfd8258.png] 

⇒ **Simple Interest** for 3 years = Rs. 1080 − Rs. 900 = Rs. 180

⇒ **Simple Interest** for 1 year = 180 ÷ 3 = Rs. 60

⇒ **Simple Interest** for 2 years = 60 × 2 = Rs. 120

⇒ **Principal (P)** = Amount₂ − SI₂ = 900 − 120 = Rs. 780

⇒ **Annual Rate (R)** = (SI × 100) ÷ (P × T)

⇒ R = (60 × 100) ÷ (780 × 1) = 100 ÷ 13

⇒ R ≈ 7.6923%

**∴ The correct answer is 7.69 percent.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Calculation of Rate

Rate (R) can be calculated using 100 × Interest ÷ (Principal × Time). Always ensure the interest and time period correspond to each other.

Nature of Simple Interest

In **Simple Interest**, the interest amount remains **constant** for every equal time interval, as it is always calculated on the original **Principal**.

Amount Relation

Amount (A) = P(1 + RT/100). If you have two different amounts for two time periods, the difference in amounts gives the interest for the difference in time.</p

questions.question: The slant height and radius of a right circular cone are in the ratio 29 ∶ 20. If its volume is 4838.4 π cm³, then its radius is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Given ratio of Slant height (l) : Radius (r) = 29 : 20.

Using Pythagorean triplet (20, 21, 29), the height (h) corresponds to 21 parts.

Volume part = 1/3 × r² × h = 1/3 × 20² × 21 = 2800 units³.

Comparing with actual volume: x³ = 4838.4 / 2800 = 1.728 ⇒ x = 1.2.

Radius (r) = 20 × 1.2 = 24 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 24 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of l : r = 29 : 20

Volume of cone (V) = 4838.4 π cm³

**Formula:**

Volume of cone = (1/3) π r² h

Relation between l, r, and h: l² = r² + h²

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a3fb185ab9f9f63f34bfeb38ae83f596f0fb75ec374d80fb0ec2d9d78ca0449c.png] 

Let common ratio be x. Then r = 20x and l = 29x.

⇒ h = √(l² − r²) = √((29x)² − (20x)²)

⇒ h = √(841x² − 400x²) = √(441x²) = 21x

⇒ Volume = (1/3) × π × (20x)² × (21x) = 4838.4 π

⇒ (1/3) × 400x² × 21x = 4838.4

⇒ 400 × 7x³ = 4838.4

⇒ 2800x³ = 4838.4

⇒ x³ = 4838.4 ÷ 2800 = 1.728

⇒ x = ³√1.728 = 1.2

⇒ Radius (r) = 20x = 20 × 1.2 = 24 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 24 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Curved Surface Area of Cone

The lateral surface area or CSA of a right circular cone is given by the formula CSA = πrl, where r is radius and l is slant height.

Total Surface Area of Cone

The TSA includes the base area and the curved surface area, calculated as TSA = πr(r + l).

Pythagorean Relation in Cones

In any right circular cone, the height (h), radius (r), and slant height (l) always satisfy the right-angled triangle property l² = r² + h².</p

questions.question: If LCM of 6 and 7 is half of the LCM of (x, y) and if x is 12, what will be the value of y?

questions.question: A cat starts running from point A at the speed of 15 km/hr for 1 hour after which a dog starts chasing the cat at the speed of 20 km/hr from the same point A. Find the distance to be travelled by the dog to catch the cat.

questions.question: Which state has emerged as the leader in the digitisation of enumeration forms during the third phase of the **Special Intensive Revision (SIR)** of electoral rolls, according to officials in June 2026?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Mizoram**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Mizoram** has taken the lead nationwide in the digitisation of electoral roll forms during the third phase of the **Special Intensive Revision (SIR)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mizoram** emerged as the leader among **16 states and 3 union territories** by completing **68.05%** of the digitisation process.
 
• **Manipur**, in comparison, achieved only **27.11%**, placing it far behind Mizoram.
 
• Within Mizoram, the **Khawzawl district** leads with **96.16%** digitisation, followed by **Champhai** (92.57%) and **Serchhip** (90.93%).
 
• The state's capital district, **Aizawl**, recorded a digitisation rate of **51.95%**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• A total of **1,301 Block Level Officers (BLOs)** were entrusted with the enumeration process across the state.
 
• Enrolment form distribution has reached **99.90%** completion state-wide, with districts like **Champhai, Serchhip, and Hnahthial** achieving 100% distribution.
 
• The **Mamit district**, which borders **Bangladesh and Tripura**, slightly lagged behind with a **95.84%** completion rate in form distribution.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• The **Election Commission of India (ECI)** media & communication conference was recently held at the **India International Institute of Democracy and Election Management (IIIDEM)** in **New Delhi**.
 
• The conference was attended by Chief Election Commissioner **Gyanesh Kumar** and Election Commissioners **Sukhbir Singh Sandhu** and **Vivek Joshi**.
 
• The Mizoram delegation at the conference was led by Joint Chief Electoral Officer **Ethel Rothangpuii**.
